messages:
kevin (oncall): FYI — quick post-incident debrief from the KMS policy drift alert. sec-bot fired, we gated traffic, and rotated the affected service key. Sharing action items we need to own this week.

sarah (eng-security): TL;DR — root cause: temporary CI job with an overly permissive role pushed a KMS policy that allowed list/get on key metadata from a non-prod SA. No plaintext secrets exfil detected, but audit gaps made timeline fuzzy.

jamal (sre): Thanks. Confirmed containment steps: reverted policy, revoked SA keys, and throttled CI runners for 30m. Observability note: CloudAudit logs for key changes were delayed ~7m.

maria (infra): Actionable backlog I created: RW-3421 rotate all keys used by CI, RW-3422 add policy drift detector (low-latency), RW-3423 add KMS-change alert to PagerDuty if AUTO_FLAG. Links: https://infra.internal/rw/3421

adele (product-security): Two policy changes we should make before Monday: 1) disallow wildcard principals in KMS policy bindings for non-admin namespaces; 2) require PR + approver for any policy-modifying CI job.

kevin (oncall): Assignments: RW-3421 -> @maria (due EOD Thu), RW-3422 -> @jamal (POC by Wed), RW-3423 -> @sarah (add tests + docs). Can folks ack? :white_check_mark:

maria (infra): Ack. I'll start key rotation plan and post exact window + rollback.

jamal (sre): Ack. For RW-3422 I'll prototype a small lambda that watches auditlog proto and emits a high-severity event on policy diffs. Will add a unit test harness.

sarah (eng-security): I'll update the incident runbook (inc/runs/kms-policy-change.md) with clearer detection heuristics and add the 7-minute audit delay note. Also schedule a 60-min tabletop next week to validate the runbook. Proposed times: Tue 10am or Thu 2pm.

adele (product-security): Recommend we add an entry to the compliance checklist: monthly verification of KMS bindings + snapshot retention policy. Also, let's tighten retention for admin audit logs from 90 -> 365 days for forensic purposes.

kevin (oncall): sec-bot, please attach the timeline and raw audit logs to the incident ticket RW-3419 and mark as "post-incident-review".

sec-bot: Attached audit bundle to RW-3419. Generated timeline: https://incidents.internal/rw/3419/timeline (encrypted).

jamal (sre): One more technical note: the CI job runs with transient credentials and was allowed to call `SetIamPolicy` on the KMS resource via a broad role. Proposed quick policy snippet to deny that from CI pool:

```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {
      "role": "roles/cloudkms.admin",
      "members": ["serviceAccount:infra-admin@redwood.com"],
      "condition": {
        "title": "deny-ci-mods",
        "expression": "!(request.auth.aud.startsWith(\\"ci-runner-\\"))"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

maria (infra): That condition looks good; I'll test in staging. Also will add an automated post-deploy check that fails the job if it attempts policy writes.

sarah (eng-security): Next steps summary for the thread (I'll paste into RW-3419):
- Rotate affected keys (owner: maria, RW-3421, due EOD Thu)
- Add policy-drift detector + PD alerts (owner: jamal, RW-3422, POC Wed)
- Add automated post-deploy policy-write blocker for CI (owner: maria, RW-3424)
- Update runbook & docs + schedule tabletop (owner: sarah, RW-3425, table-top Tue/Thu)
- Increase audit retention and compliance checklist update (owner: adele, RW-3426)

kevin (oncall): Perfect. If nobody objects, i'll mark RW-3419 as "action items assigned" and close the incident channel for casual chatter. We'll reconvene after the tabletop. :lock: :calendar: 

adele (product-security): No objections. Add me to the tabletop invite.

maria (infra): One Q — can we throttle key rotation to avoid rate limits? I'll include safe-window in RW-3421.

jamal (sre): Good catch. Add a step to stagger rotations and monitor KMS quotas.

sarah (eng-security): Thanks team. Closing thread for now — please update the respective RW tickets with progress and ping if you need extra hands. :eyes:
